name: EPIC 212755436

text.card: A red giant 3,754 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.98 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,010 K at its surface.
